claims.claimText: U.S. population growth slowed to 0.5% between July 1, 2024 and July 1, 2025.

sourceLocator.value: News Release > Population Growth Slows Due to Decline in Net International Migration

claims.supportNote: The Census press-kit page states the 0.5% national population growth rate for July 1, 2024 to July 1, 2025.

claims.claimText: In the second quarter of 2026, real value added increased 2.5% for private services-producing industries, 2.3% for private goods-producing industries, and less than 0.1% for government; real GDP increased at a 2.2% annual rate.

sourceLocator.value: GDP by Industry > current release summary, September 30, 2026

claims.supportNote: BEA current release summary provides the sector value-added changes and overall real GDP annual rate.

claims.claimText: The September 30, 2026 National Transportation Statistics update added new data to the Number of U.S. Airports and U.S. Vehicle-Miles tables.

sourceLocator.value: This month, the following tables received new data

claims.supportNote: BTS explicitly lists Number of U.S. Airports (1-3) and U.S. Vehicle-Miles (1-35, 1-35M) among tables receiving new data.

claims.claimText: U.S. gross domestic R&D expenditures were $1.009 trillion in 2024 on a purchasing-power-parity basis, equal to 3.4% of U.S. GDP; the United States accounted for 29% of global R&D performance.

sourceLocator.value: Executive Summary > Discovery: R&D Activity and Research Publications > R&D Activity

claims.supportNote: NCSES executive summary reports U.S. 2024 R&D expenditures, R&D intensity and global share.

claims.claimText: In July 2026, U.S. goods and services exports were $310.7 billion, imports were $399.3 billion, and the goods and services deficit was $88.6 billion.

sourceLocator.value: U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services Deficit / Exports, Imports, and Balance (exhibit 1)

claims.supportNote: Joint BEA/Census release reports July 2026 exports, imports and trade balance.

claims.claimText: As of February 2026, the United States had 36,207,130 small businesses, and U.S. small businesses employed 62.3 million people, or 45.9% of private-sector workers.

sourceLocator.value: Frequently Asked Questions About Small Business 2026 > key statistics

claims.supportNote: SBA Office of Advocacy lists the small-business count and private-sector employment share.

claims.claimText: The Federal Reserve's May 2026 Financial Stability Report assessed U.S. financial-system vulnerabilities across valuation pressures, borrowing by businesses and households, financial-sector leverage, and funding risks, using market conditions and data as of April 23, 2026.

sourceLocator.value: Overview > Overview of financial system vulnerabilities

claims.supportNote: Federal Reserve overview names the four vulnerability categories and states the assessment date.

claims.claimText: According to China's 2025 1% National Population Sample Survey, the national population was 1,405.45 million; 22.86% were aged 60 and over and 15.87% were aged 65 and over.

sourceLocator.value: 2025年全国1%人口抽样调查主要数据公报 > 一、全国人口 / 三、年龄构成

claims.supportNote: 国家统计局公报直接给出调查时点全国人口及60岁、65岁以上人口占比。

claims.claimText: In August 2026, China's value added of industrial enterprises above designated size increased 5.2% year on year; manufacturing increased 6.1%, and computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing increased 17.2%.

sourceLocator.value: 8月份规模以上工业增加值 > 分三大门类 / 分行业

claims.supportNote: 国家统计局最新发布直接给出8月工业、制造业和电子设备制造业增速。

claims.claimText: From September 21 to 27, 2026, China's monitored transport and logistics system carried 83.026 million tonnes by national railway, recorded 55.325 million expressway truck trips, and handled 278.781 million tonnes of cargo at monitored ports.

sourceLocator.value: 9月21日—9月27日全国物流保通保畅运行数据

claims.supportNote: 交通运输部周度数据直接描述铁路、公路与港口物流基础设施当前运行量。

claims.claimText: China's R&D expenditure reached 3.9262 trillion yuan in 2025, with R&D intensity at 2.80% of GDP; basic research expenditure reached 277.8 billion yuan.

claims.supportNote: 国家统计局成就报告直接给出2025年R&D总量、强度和基础研究投入。

claims.claimText: In August 2026, China's international trade in goods and services recorded exports of RMB 2,879.3 billion and imports of RMB 2,238.6 billion, for a surplus of RMB 640.7 billion.

sourceLocator.value: SAFE Releases Data on International Trade in Goods and Services of China in August 2026

claims.supportNote: 国家外汇管理局月度数据直接给出货物和服务贸易出口、进口及顺差。
